annotation_description: GPT52 Trash activated Maelstrom of the Spirit Dragon's expensive tutor ability (costing 4 mana + tap + sacrifice) during the combat phase of turn 8 with only 4 lands, sacrificing a land to search for a Dragon card they already have multiples of in hand (Magmatic Hellkite, Clarion Conqueror, Dragonhawk). This leaves them with only 3 lands going forward, making it much harder to cast their 4-5 mana dragons. They could have simply tapped Maelstrom for colored mana to help cast a dragon next turn, or played Cavern of Souls + Momo this turn to start building board presence. Sacrificing a land when you're already land-light and have dragons in hand is wasteful - the tutor finds something they don't need while setting back their mana development by a full turn.
